courses.title: Computer Environment
courses.description: This course provides a detailed examination of the fundamental elements on which computers are based. Topics include number systems and computation, electricity and basic circuits, logic circuits, memory, computer architecture, and operating systems. Operational code and assembly languages are discussed and then implemented on a hardware platform, such as a personal computer or an autonomous vehicle.

courses.title: High-Level Programming I: The C Programming Language
courses.description: This course serves as a foundation for all high-level programming courses and projects by introducing control flow through statement grouping, decision making, case selection, and procedure iteration as well as basic data types.

courses.title: High-Level Programming II: The C++ Programming Language
courses.description: This course introduces the C++ language with particular emphasis on its object-oriented features.

courses.title: Operating Systems I: Man-Machine Interface
courses.description: This course presents an overview of modern operating systems as implemented on personal computers.

courses.title: Computer Graphics I
courses.description: This course presents fundamental mathematical elements, data structures, and algorithms useful for animating and viewing 2D primitives.

courses.title: Advanced C/C++
courses.description: This course builds on the foundation created in the first two high-level programming courses and presents advanced topics.

courses.title: Game Implementation Techniques
courses.description: This course presents game implementation techniques and engine architecture.

courses.title: Computer Graphics II
courses.description: This course examines the mathematical elements and algorithms used in real-time 3D computer graphics.

courses.title: Computer Networks I: Interprocess Communication
courses.description: This course introduces hierarchical network communication in a distributed computing environment.

courses.title: Data Structures
courses.description: This course introduces classical abstract data types and algorithm complexity.

courses.title: Advanced Computer Graphics I
courses.description: This course introduces algorithms essential to creating photorealistic images in interactive simulations.

courses.title: Low-Level Programming
courses.description: This course introduces modern microprocessor architectures and assembly languages.

courses.title: User Interface and User Experience Design

courses.title: Algorithm Analysis

courses.title: Advanced Computer Graphics II
